verdict.rationale: A public registry service could reasonably publish an llms.txt or agent-oriented docs, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only human-oriented web guidance on incorporation, fees and filings, with no llms.txt or agent-specific documentation. The keyless JSON response from the open.canada.ca CKAN open-data API is a general data layer, not agent-oriented docs for the registry, which itself documents no API.
